verdict.rationale: Notion offers the building blocks for this: always-on agents and Custom Agents managed via API, webhooks that fire on new pages and property changes, and REST/MCP access to update database properties. Together these could let an AI triage incoming items, but nothing in the evidence documents automatic bug or task triage or prioritization as a capability, so the workflow must be assembled by the user. missing for 10: a documented AI triage/prioritization feature for incoming bugs and tasks, first-party guidance showing agents setting priority or status on new database items, and independent or hands-on confirmation that such a workflow works.
